description: Implementation of the CmduPeer class handling CMDU message sending, forwarding, and receiving in the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: CmduPeer
classes.description: Handles CMDU message transmission, forwarding, and reception within the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: CmduPeer::send_cmdu
methods.description: Serializes and sends a CMDU message over a network connection.

methods.name: CmduPeer::forward_cmdu
methods.description: Serializes and forwards a received CMDU message, swapping byte order before and after.

methods.name: CmduPeer::receive_cmdus
methods.description: Receives data, parses CMDUs, and invokes a handler for each parsed CMDU.
